result_text:
The Stop hook is failing again on the same test, and nothing I changed is involved.

`src/social.test.ts > Social Providers > should refresh the access token` makes a real request to `accounts.google.com`. This environment has no network access, so it fails with `getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN`. I confirmed that earlier by running the file myself. The other 56 tests in it pass. The hook output is cut off before the failure summary, but the log lines it does show are from that same test.

I haven't edited or skipped that test, because the project rules forbid weakening tests to get a run to pass. The hook will keep failing here until the test can reach Google, or the hook run excludes it.

The feature is finished. The last-login-method tests pass (26 of 26) and `tsc --noEmit` is clean.
